flow.common.insurerLine: Cover is provided by Ardenne Assurance. Beloy runs this service on behalf of BMW France.
flow.stepper.label: Your progress
flow.landing.title: Insured from the moment you collect the keys
flow.landing.lead: Motor insurance made for electric driving. Alongside your car, we can look after your home wallbox, your charging cable, your battery and your glass, and come to the rescue if you ever run out of charge.
flow.landing.fromNote: Starting price for the Essential package. Your own price depends on you and your car.
flow.landing.benefits.delivery.title: Starts on delivery day
flow.landing.benefits.delivery.body: Your cover begins the day your BMW is delivered. Nothing to sort out at the last minute.
flow.landing.benefits.charging.title: Charging, covered
flow.landing.benefits.charging.body: Protect the wallbox on your wall and the cable in your boot, two things a standard policy usually leaves out.
flow.landing.benefits.battery.title: Battery peace of mind
flow.landing.benefits.battery.body: Cover for capacity loss that goes beyond the manufacturer’s warranty.
flow.landing.benefits.assistance.title: Never stranded
flow.landing.benefits.assistance.body: Run out of charge and we’ll get you and your car moving again.
flow.vehicle.title: Let’s check your car
flow.vehicle.lead: We’ve filled this in from your order. If anything has changed, you can correct it here.
flow.vehicle.deliveryDateHint: Your cover starts on this day, so it needs to be a date in the future.
flow.driver.title: Tell us about the main driver
flow.driver.lead: The person who’ll be behind the wheel most of the time. A few quick questions and we’ll have your price.
flow.driver.birthDateHint: The main driver needs to be 18 or over.
flow.driver.licenceSinceHint: The date you passed your test, as shown on your licence.
flow.driver.claimsLabel: At-fault claims in the last 3 years
flow.driver.claimsHint: Only count claims where you were found responsible. Enter 0 if there were none.
flow.driver.postcodeHint: Where the car is kept overnight.
flow.driver.parkingLabel: Where is it parked at night?
flow.driver.chargingLabel: Where do you charge most often?
flow.validation.summary: A few answers need your attention.
flow.validation.chooseOne: Please choose one of the options.
flow.validation.deliveryNotFuture: The delivery date needs to be in the future.
flow.validation.tooYoung: The main driver needs to be at least 18.
flow.validation.dateInFuture: This date can’t be in the future.
flow.validation.licenceBeforeBirth: The licence date needs to be after the date of birth.
flow.validation.claimsInvalid: Please enter a whole number, 0 or more.
flow.validation.kmInvalid: Please enter a distance in kilometres, using numbers only.
flow.validation.postcodeInvalid: Please enter a 5-digit French postcode, like 75011.
flow.validation.emailInvalid: Please enter an email address like name@example.fr.
flow.validation.phoneInvalid: Please enter a phone number we can reach you on, like 06 12 34 56 78.
flow.validation.consentRequired: Please tick this box to continue.
flow.cover.title: Choose your cover
flow.cover.lead: Every package includes full motor insurance for your BMW. Pick the one that suits you, then add any extras you’d like.
flow.cover.frequencyLabel: How would you like to pay?
flow.cover.frequencyHint: Paying monthly spreads the cost, but works out a little more expensive over the year.
flow.cover.packageIncludesNone: Add only the extras you need
flow.cover.addonsLead: Make it yours. The price of each extra is added to your package.
flow.cover.addonsEmpty: Choose a package first to see which extras you can add.
flow.cover.totalEmpty: Choose a package to see your price
flow.packages.essential.name: Essential
flow.packages.essential.description: Solid motor cover to build on. Add only the extras you want.
flow.packages.comfort.name: Comfort
flow.packages.comfort.description: Extra reassurance for everyday electric driving.
flow.packages.integral.name: Integral
flow.packages.integral.description: Our most complete cover, so you can simply enjoy the drive.
flow.addons.WALLBOX.name: Home wallbox
flow.addons.WALLBOX.description: Your home charging unit is covered, including any damage during installation.
flow.addons.CABLE.name: Charging cable
flow.addons.CABLE.description: Lost, stolen or damaged charging cable? We’ll cover it.
flow.addons.BATTERY.name: Battery health
flow.addons.BATTERY.description: Protects you if your battery loses capacity beyond the manufacturer’s warranty threshold.
flow.addons.STRANDED.name: Out-of-charge assistance
flow.addons.STRANDED.description: If your battery runs flat, we’ll recover your car and take you where you need to go.
flow.addons.GLASS.name: Glass cover
flow.addons.GLASS.description: Windscreen and windows repaired or replaced, with no excess to pay.
flow.review.title: Check and confirm
flow.review.lead: Take a moment to look over your answers. You can change anything before you confirm.
flow.review.emailHint: We’ll send your policy documents here.
flow.review.phoneHint: Only used if we need to reach you about your policy.
flow.review.documentsLead: Please read these before you confirm. They explain exactly what is and isn’t covered.
flow.review.documents.preContractual: Pre-contractual Information Sheet – BMW Electric Cover
flow.review.documents.generalConditions: General Conditions – Ardenne Assurance EV Cover (ref. AA-EV-FR-2026)
flow.review.consents.preContractual: I have received and read the pre-contractual information and the Insurance Product Information Document.
flow.review.consents.generalConditions: I have read and accept the General Conditions.
flow.review.consents.dataProcessing: I agree to Ardenne Assurance and Beloy using my personal data to set up and manage my policy, as described in the Data Protection Notice.
flow.review.reassurance: Nothing is charged now. On the next screen you’ll get a reference to pay at a cash machine or in your banking app.
flow.review.submit: Confirm and get my payment reference
flow.payment.title: Your policy is ready
flow.payment.lead: One last step: pay using the details below. Your cover starts on {date}, as soon as your payment has arrived.
flow.payment.amountAnnualHint: Your full year, in one payment
flow.payment.keepSafe: Take a screenshot or write these details down before you leave this page.
flow.payment.copyFailed: We couldn’t copy that. Please write it down instead.
flow.payment.nextStep1: Open your banking app, or go to any cash machine, and choose to pay with a reference.
flow.payment.nextStep2: Enter the entity, the reference and the amount exactly as shown above.
flow.payment.nextStep3: Pay by {date}. After that, this reference stops working.
flow.payment.nextStep4: Once your payment arrives, your policy is active and your documents are on their way.
flow.errors.invalid_request.title: Some details need another look
flow.errors.invalid_request.body: We couldn’t use some of the information you gave us. Please check your answers and try again.
flow.errors.quote_not_found.title: We couldn’t find your quote
flow.errors.quote_not_found.body: Your quote is no longer available. Let’s get you a fresh one, it only takes a minute.
flow.errors.quote_expired.title: Your quote has expired
flow.errors.quote_expired.body: Prices are only held for a limited time and this one has run out. We can get you an updated price with the answers you’ve already given.
flow.errors.driver_ineligible.title: We can’t offer cover online for this driver
flow.errors.driver_ineligible.body: To be covered, the main driver needs to have held a licence for at least two years and to have had no more than two at-fault claims in the last three years. If one of your answers isn’t quite right, you can change it.
flow.errors.consent_required.title: We need your agreement
flow.errors.consent_required.body: Please tick all three boxes in “Your agreement” so we can issue your policy.
flow.errors.internal_error.title: We’ve hit a problem on our side
flow.errors.internal_error.body: It’s nothing you did. Please give it another try in a moment.
flow.errors.network.title: We couldn’t connect
flow.errors.network.body: Your answers are safe. Check that you’re online, then try again.
flow.errors.unknown.title: That step didn’t go through
flow.errors.unknown.body: Please try again. If it keeps happening, start a new quote and we’ll take it from there.
